# Sirimilla Vinay

> Sirimilla Vinay (also written Vinay Sirimilla) is a Network Administrator in Hyderabad, Telangana, India, with three current roles: Network Administrator at SportsMart.com (since July 2025), Network Administrator at Jobways.com (since September 2024) and Product Listing Manager at SportsMart.com (since July 2025). Vinay also builds VinaX, a personal line of free software, and is not looking for new roles.

## Website

- [sirimillavinay.online](https://sirimillavinay.online/): personal website with about, experience, projects, skills, education and contact sections

## Projects

- [VinaX Code](https://www.npmjs.com/package/vinax-code): an AI coding assistant for the terminal (npm, macOS / Windows / Linux). Docs: https://vinax-proxy.onrender.com/
- [VinaX Music](https://www.vinaxmusic.online/): free, ad-free music streaming built for India, with the VinaX AI assistant at https://www.vinaxmusic.online/vinaxai

## Education

- National Trade Certificate (NTC), Computer Operator & Programming Assistant (COPA), Govt. ITI Mahabubabad, 2023–2024
- Secondary School Certificate (SSC), TSTWR School (Boys), Maripeda, 2023
